title: Card 3: key = userId: ek user ki har khabar ek tukde me, kram sirf tukde ke andar. Same key = same partition

callouts.red: Poore topic ki saari khabar ek hi kram me rakhein?
callouts.green: Bekaar: Arpan aur Sita ki khabar ka aapas me kram kisi ko chahiye hi nahi. Aur ek kram = ek hi tukda = phir wahi bheed

callouts.red: Arpan ne naam badla, pehle A phir B. A atka, B pehle pahuncha, A baad me
callouts.green: Har khabar pe number lagta (1, 2). Kafka number dekh ke sahi kram me rakhta: pehle A, phir B. Naam: idempotent producer

callouts.red: Bheed badhi, tukde 10 se 20 kar diye
callouts.green: Tukda key se tay hota (hash % 10). Ab % 20, to Arpan ki nayi khabar doosre tukde me, purani pehle me: kuch der kram toota. Ilaaj: tukde shuru me hi zyada rakho

callouts.red: Ek celebrity ki itni khabar ki uska akela tukda bhar gaya
callouts.green: Key ke peeche number jodo (userId#1, #2), khabar kai tukdon me bat jaati. Par us user ka kram nahi rahega, isliye tabhi jab kram zaroori na ho

callouts.red: Key di hi nahi to? Khabar kisi bhi tukde me jaati, Arpan ka kram nahi bachta. Isliye pehle poochho: kram poore topic ka chahiye ya ek user ka?
callouts.green: RabbitMQ / SQS me kram? Pakka nahi milta. SQS FIFO ya ek hi padhne wala ho tab kram milta, par speed kam

kyun: Kram sirf EK tukde (partition) ke andar pakka hota hai. Isliye jiska kram chahiye usi ko key banao (userId): same key hamesha same tukde me jaati, to Arpan ki khabar kram se rehti
ab: Arpan ne naam do baar badla (A, phir B), purana reh gaya
agla: ab ek service ki kai machine padh rahi: Arpan ko kitne email? (card 4)
